title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LOCAL POLICE IN CITIES AND TOWNS OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS AND APPROPRIATING ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND DOLLARS MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, FOR THEIR MAINTENANCE.

title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép thành lập cảnh sát địa phương tại các thành phố và thị trấn trên quần đảo Philippines và cấp ngân sách 150.000 đô la Hoa Kỳ để duy trì lực lượng này

title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Otorisasi Pendirian Polisi Lokal di Kota dan Kotamadya di Kepulauan Filipina serta Pengalokasian Seratus Lima Puluh Ribu Dolar Amerika Serikat untuk Pemeliharaannya
title.ms: Akta Mengiktiraf Penubuhan Polis Tempatan di Bandar dan Perbandaran di Kepulauan Filipina dan Mengeluarkan Peruntukan Seratus Lima Puluh Ribu Dolar Amerika Syarikat untuk Penyelenggarannya

text.en:
The Military Governor is hereby authorized to establish a police force for the maintenance of law
and order in such of the cities and towns of these Islands as may by him be deemed desirable and
advantageous to the public interest.

The sum of one hundred and fifty thousand dollars, money of the United States, is hereby
appropriated out of any money in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, for the purpose of paying
the expenses incident to the organization and maintenance of the police established pursuant to the
provisions of section one hereof.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 12, 1900.
